name: LOVATO FB01B3N fuse holder
summary: DIN-rail fuse holder for three phases and neutral using 10 × 38 mm fuse cartridges.
description: Reserve the holder body and the opening space needed to access the cartridges. Its four-module assembly belongs on the rail layout; fuse ratings belong in the circuit schedule.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The manufacturer identifies this version without a status indicator. Keep the neutral position and phase order consistent with the wiring diagram.
The holder rating is not the rating or operating characteristic of the fuse installed in it.
drawingChecklist: Reserve cartridge-carrier opening and terminal access.
